QuestInfo.name: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p503#, the master weaponcrafter of #m10004000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my weaponcrafting skills.
QuestInfo.1: #p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat #r#o24#s#k and craft #b1 #t1422003##k to bring back to him.
QuestInfo.2: #p503#, the master weapon craftsman of #m10004000#, was impressed by my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130000#. It looks like a special item that can change an equipment's stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should try it out.

0.0: I've heard that you've become quite the weaponcrafter, and I want to see for myself if the rumors are true. Judging by your tools and your confidence, it seems you've built up a fair bit of skill. Care to show me?

yes.0: Perfect timing! I actually needed a tool for some repairs in my bathroom--lucky me, haha! Go defeat #r#o24#s#k and craft #b1 #t1422003##k, then bring it back. #o24#s can be found around #m10001000#, so it shouldn't be too difficult. I'll be waiting!

no.0: Looks like you haven't quite reached that level of skill, have you?

1.0: Let's see... This is remarkably well made. I'm genuinely impressed you've reached this level of craftsmanship. Yes, this is the quality expected of a true weaponcrafter. Your dedication to honing your skills is admirable. Looks like I owe you a special reward.

yes.0: This #t4130000# is a unique item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's stats. It's very unstable, so sometimes the results may be disappointing--but, if handled well, it might create something far beyond your expectations.
yes.1: If you want to test the limits of your weaponcrafting skill, I highly recommend giving it a try. Just... don't blame me if the results aren't what you hoped for, hahaha!

mob.0: It seems you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. No slacking off!

item.0: It seems you haven't gathered the material I asked for. No slacking off!
